# Project Guidelines

## GitHub Publishing

- When making project changes requested by the user, commit the relevant changes and push them to `main` on `https://github.com/pravin26082006/beast-fitness-factory` without asking for confirmation.
- Stage only files related to the requested project changes. Never force-push or include unrelated user changes.
- If the remote has diverged or the requested changes cannot be safely pushed, stop and explain the issue.
